scope: Internal author review; do not include this file in anonymous submission source.

headline.claim: GEMM 8-core stock-to-pipeline paired process speedup: mean 1.63831099, sample SD 0.00521384; common-cache mean 1.00009651, sample SD 0.00898300
headline.check: 18 original records, identical input records/CPU sets/wire-map hashes and quality gates; paired ratios recomputed
headline.reported_statistics: statistics/statistics.json: evidence/gemm/8/stock-to-pipeline; arithmetic mean +/- sample SD, n=3

confirmation.claim: 36 legal runs; three circuits each three paired runtime repeats in rebuild and reuse
confirmation.restriction: Separate cohort; fixed-placement runtime repeats on a shared host, not additional placement seeds

storage_ablation.claim: 171 legal native samples; 120 formal samples; bounded does not stably outperform pipeline

interpolation_semantics.claim: 2400 fixtures, 4800 bitwise comparisons, zero mismatches, mutation detection counts 1905 and 1902
interpolation_semantics.restriction: Synthetic extracted-function tests; not 4800 native routing runs

scalar_semantics.restriction: Cell equivalence does not imply reduction of process RSS

scaling_and_fresh_layouts.restriction: One runtime per fresh layout and configuration; three circuits with two layouts each; core-count groups at different times

large_failures.restriction: No process speedup from failed routing or mixed graph-load/graph-generation boundaries

post_optimization_cost_bound.location: configurations: workers=8, variant=pipeline; lookahead_fraction; speedup_if_lookahead_halved; ideal_speedup_if_lookahead_free
post_optimization_cost_bound.restriction: Ratios computed per sample before arithmetic mean and sample SD; idealized unchanged other costs

source_code.restriction: Frozen study manifests bind the actually tested source/binary snapshots; current working source is explanatory

excluded: Historical independent cuda_target speedups as evidence for native CPU/GPU or CPU-only claims
All failed, timed-out, diagnostic-only and cache-qualification runs as legal process-speedup baselines
Unmeasured FPGA board or fabricated-3D-device performance

repeat_statistics.claim: 222 original performance runs, 98 absolute-time configurations, 246 paired observations and 106 comparison groups; manuscript uses means and n-1 sample SD; historical medians retained only in audit data
repeat_statistics.scope: Historical 222 records retained as a subset of expanded 603; no solver invoked during manuscript revision.
repeat_statistics.reporting_change: Explicit reporting revision; same frozen observations, historical selection records and failed-run denominators retained

expanded_statistics.claim: 603 formal observations: 414 legal full-flow, 189 construction-only; 952 absolute metric summaries; 90 actual cache-sequence processes analyzed separately.
expanded_statistics.reporting: Arithmetic mean and n-1 sample SD; paired ratios first; equal-circuit geometric aggregation; no pooling across hosts.

three_graph_construction.claim: 36 completed formal construction runs across all three width-120 3D graphs; capped routing tails excluded from legal full flows.

qualified_3d_full_flow.claim: 72 formal full runs on prequalified LSTM-s2 and BNN-s1/s2; equal-circuit rebuild process aggregate 1.680709988; retain 3/6 qualification failures.

k6_cache_and_alternatives.claim: 96 formal full runs, 90 cache-sequence requests and six compressed alternatives; cohorts and quality boundaries separate.

construction_scaling.claim: 90 formal construction runs, 1/2/4/8/16 cores; BNN/DLA Pipeline scales about 12x from one to sixteen cores.

global_loop_control.claim: 54 construction runs and 12 clma full runs; Flat/Pipeline comparison attributes dominant gain to global task exposure, not unique pipeline primitive.

large_2d.claim: 12 full and nine construction runs; separately prepared original KOIOS 2D BNN; no CHANZ, full paired process speedup 1.356 +/- 0.028.

dataset_inventory.claim: 14 circuit/fabric rows, 22 layout instances; 2D/3D classified using architecture, graph, layers, and actual routed transitions. Width-120 counts corrected using actual XML rather than stale geometry fields.

method_decomposition.claim: Private floods, original-order strict-delay paired-cost reduction, source/target layer slices, global scheduling, slice dependencies and bounded representation. Existing oneTBB primitives and inherited vertical cost model are attributed.

future_hardware.claim: Defined task/result/ordered-commit interface and replication resource costs; no measured GPU, FPGA board or fabricated device performance.
